about_the_game:
Chick Game Demo contains:

  • 2 full day/night cycles

  • 6 different types of predators that attack at night (skunk, raccoon, fox, boar, wolf, bear)

  • 3 different types of buffs/upgrades (speed, damage, health)

  • 3 different uses for scrap collected (reinforce the coop, build a scarecrow, build a junk pile)

Play as the brave and loyal rooster - defending the coop at night from a variety of predators and planning ahead each day through upgrades and using scrap to build fortifications.

content_descriptors.notes:
The player acts as a rooster who is armed with a shotgun at night to defend his coop and flock from wild predator animals. Enemies have a "poof" effect when shot, however there are red "scratch" marks when hit with a melee attack.

The player can also woo hens to show them affection and is NOT intended to be sexually explicit.

short_description: An FPSCG (first-person survival chicken game) where you care for your flock by day and defend your chicken coop from waves of predators by night as a powerful rooster.
